parameters.name: FilePathQuotas
parameters.description: The details of the quota rules to apply to directories.

sub_parameters.name: MaxDepth
sub_parameters.description: The number of subdirectory levels to traverse under `FilePathId`. A value of 1 indicates that only the first-level subdirectories are traversed. A value of 0 indicates that all levels are traversed to the deepest level.

sub_parameters.name: QuotaIds
sub_parameters.description: The IDs of the rules to apply, separated by commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: Strategy
sub_parameters.description:
The mode in which rules take effect on existing files. Valid values:

- **missing**: Rules take effect only when they are missing. This is the default value.
- **all**: Rules take effect on all files.
